description: Check an artifact output against its source pack (closed world). Every name in output.refs, every *Ref / *Refs value, every `backticked` name and every first cell of a table row must exist in the pack. Returns passed, checked, unresolved [{name, where}] and warnings. If it fails, fix only the listed names (one repair attempt is recommended) and check again. Pass the stamp to prove the pack was not modified. Read-only.

output.description: Your artifact output. Must follow the template's output contract, including refs.

pack.description: The pack object returned by build_source_pack, unchanged.

stamp.description: Optional. The stamp returned with the pack; its packHash is verified.
